title: My Dog and the Red Apples

paragraphs.text: I have a little dog. His name is Coco. He is small and white. He likes the apple orchard.
paragraphs.translation: 我有一只小狗。他叫可可。他又小又白。他很喜欢苹果园。

paragraphs.text: My family has a big orchard. There are many apple trees. The trees are tall and green. Red apples grow on the trees.
paragraphs.translation: 我们家有一个大果园。那里有很多苹果树。树又高又绿。红苹果就长在树上。

paragraphs.text: Coco runs in the orchard. He can run very fast. He has a red ball. He plays with the ball.
paragraphs.translation: 可可在果园里跑来跑去。他跑得可快了。他有一个红球。他和球一起玩。

paragraphs.text: My dad picks big apples. My mom puts them in a basket. I eat a sweet red apple. It is very nice.
paragraphs.translation: 爸爸摘大苹果。妈妈把苹果放进篮子里。我吃一个又红又甜的苹果。味道真不错。

paragraphs.text: Coco sees a green apple. It falls from the tree. He wants to play with it. The apple rolls away.
paragraphs.translation: 可可看见一个绿苹果。它从树上掉下来。他想和它玩。可苹果滚走了。

paragraphs.text: We go home in the evening. Coco is tired and happy. He sleeps with his ball. I love my little dog.
paragraphs.translation: 傍晚我们回家去。可可又累又开心。他抱着自己的球睡着了。我爱我的小狗。
